title: S4 pii-governance-route lens — input
description: Service-pack variant of the pii-governance lens (docs/decisions/041). Governs request/response parameters and query bind values, not captured LLM content -- see skills/s4-pii-governance/io/input.schema.json for the genai-pack variant, whose points are llm_generation only.

points.description: surface_map.json points of kind http_server_route, declarative_route, or db_query only -- the lens designs for these, no others.

context.description: context.yaml, if an interview has run -- optional; the lens must produce valid, complete signals for every point with or without it, but pii_presence/data_governance_map (when present, and when the point's own workflow_hint resolves to that workflow) change how strict the designed fields must be.
